overview: The Akhevan Barracks house the disciplined military forces of Ka Vethan, trained in void‑arcane combat and Praesertum doctrine.
history: Constructed during the early expansion of Ka Vethan’s military order.
Armament vaults added after the first Praesertum decree on void warfare.
Barracks expanded to support Akhevan patrols across Luclin.
Modern barracks serve as both training and command infrastructure.
hooks: A resonance training ritual destabilizes unexpectedly.
A Praesertum directive changes military protocol.
Armament vaults report anomalous void signatures.
A drill yard commander requests external assistance.
